title: Food Shop
body:
Syntax: sell <food item>  |  list

Food Shops buy cooked fish dishes, uncooked fish catches, fresh farm produce, and other food items for Ryo at the full specialty price. General stores accept the same items at half their specialty rate. Use 'sell <item>' while standing with a food shopkeeper; the food is removed from your inventory when the Ryo is paid.

Builder setup: mset <mob vnum> shopkeeper on
               mset <mob vnum> shoptype food
               mset spawn <mob vnum> <room vnum>
Optional: mset additem <mob vnum> <object vnum> to stock food for players to buy. Selecting a shop type clears custom buys overrides. Builder-made object prototypes with itemtype food also qualify.

Date: 2026-10-21
